main_text.p: tione temperiei modique materiæ, nos in omnibus ejusdem; unde in diversi ad diverfa modulamina confenfus obs-ritur: Quin & venenofam qualitatem diverfis Tarantulis effe diverfam, no-tat Kircherus: fi quæ rubri coloris iunt, depravant appetitum ad colorem ru-brum; quæ viridis ad viridem; quæ vi-riegati coloris ad varios appetitus in-clinant; quæ super aquas verfantur, hydrophilium, id est, amorem aquæ in-ducunt; quæ in locis calidis & siccis, in iram caeterofque cholericos affectus effervelcere cogunt: Atque hinc est, quòd alii nunquam quiescere soleant, nisi vitreum vas plenum aquâ manu circumferant, cum quo eosdem geftus, quos gladiatores facere solent, ridi-cula prorsus gesticulatione peragunt: Quidam ardenter videre desiderant in medio loco, faltui ad curam deputato, conchas aquâ plenas, &c. alii alia ima-ginatione impelluntur, ut plenius com-memorat prænominatus Kircherus. At-que

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off and largely illegible; only fragments remain. Some words in the running text are uncertain (e.g. "ru-brum;quæ", "viridem;quæ"), reproduced as seen with punctuation as printed.
